senses.gloss: m. pl. constr. = אֲחוֹרֵי (v. אֲחוֹרָא) behind, after.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:2:5">Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>פרי ח׳ חמרא וכ׳</he> running after (driving) an ass on a Sabbath (being forced to public labor).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:12">Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ</cite> bot. [read:] <he>קם ליה מן חוֹרוֹי מצלי</he> (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:5:3">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ</cite> top <he>מן אחורויי</he>) stood up from behind him to pray.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:6:3">Y. Sot. VII, end, 22ᵃ</cite> <he>לח׳ פרוכתא</he>, v. <cite ref="C00368"><he>גּוּל</he></cite> ch.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:5:4">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>תרין … לחוֹרוֹיי</he> two thirds of the load on his back; a. fr.
